purpose: Collect membership sign-ups and optionally create WordPress users or take payment.

fields.label: Password
fields.privacy_notes: Use only if User Registration flow is approved; activation email may be safer.

fields.label: Payment
fields.privacy_notes: Only if payment add-on and gateway are configured in test/live mode.

confirmations.name: Default
confirmations.message: Thanks for registering. Check your email for next steps.

notifications.name: Member acknowledgement
notifications.message: Do not include password or sensitive payment details.

spam_settings.turnstile: recommended if available for registration abuse

data_retention_notes: Registration and payment data require retention and access review. Consent record and wording must be reviewed for retention, export, and erase handling.
required_addons: User Registration add-on for account creation
risks: User creation, role mapping, password handling, and payment feeds are high-risk.
